2.t: And by the Night when it is still,-

3.t: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.

4.t: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.

5.t: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.

6.t: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?

7.t: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.

8.t: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.

9.t: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,

11.t: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
